# `vox-language-surface`

**Crate:** `vox-language-surface` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

Single source of truth for Vox keyword/decorator/builtin surface strings. Has no logic dependencies (only the workspace-hack unifier), so vox-compiler and vox-grammar-export can share one SSOT without a cyclic dependency.

## Crate Overview

Single source of truth for **keyword** and **decorator** surface strings exposed
to the lexer-introspection layer, LSP, MCP, and grammar docs.

This crate has **zero logic dependencies** so that both `vox-compiler` (which owns
the lexer/parser) and `vox-grammar-export` (which renders `GRAMMAR_SSOT.md`) can
depend on it without forming a cycle — `vox-compiler` depends on
`vox-grammar-export`, so the surface SSOT cannot live in `vox-compiler`.
`vox-compiler::language_surface` re-exports everything here.

Keep lexer-derived lists aligned with `vox_compiler::lexer::token::Token`.


## Public API Surface

### Constants

| Constant | Description |
|---|---|
| `LSP_KEYWORD_SNIPPETS` | LSP keyword completions: `(label, snippet)`. Includes parser-level keywords that may still lex as identifiers until dedicated tokens exist. |
| `LSP_DECORATOR_DOCS` | Decorators with dedicated lexer tokens — `(spelling, LSP doc)`.  The retired data-layer decorators (`@server`/`@table`/`@index`/`@query`/`@mutation`/ `@tool`/`@resource`) are intentionally absent: they live in [`LEXER_DEPRECATED_DECORATORS`], and LSP should steer users to the soft-keyword forms in [`LSP_KEYWORD_SNIPPETS`] instead. |
| `LSP_DECORATOR_SNIPPETS` | LSP decorator snippets: `(label, snippet)`. The retired data-layer decorators are omitted in favor of the soft-keyword snippets in [`LSP_KEYWORD_SNIPPETS`]. |
| `CONTROL_FLOW_KEYWORDS` | Control-flow and binding keywords. |
| `DECLARATION_KEYWORDS` | Declaration / structural keywords. |
| `WEB_REACTIVE_KEYWORDS` | Web / reactive / operator keywords, HTTP verbs, and the soft (contextual) data-layer keywords (`table`/`index`/`query`/`mutation`/`server`/`tool`/`resource`) — the latter have no logos `#[token]`; they remain `Token::Ident` and are recognized positionally at declaration-head position only. |
| `LEXER_KEYWORDS` | Keywords that have dedicated single-word lexer tokens (speech / strict introspection). The concatenation of [`CONTROL_FLOW_KEYWORDS`], [`DECLARATION_KEYWORDS`], and [`WEB_REACTIVE_KEYWORDS`] — guarded by the `categories_partition_lexer_keywords` test (`#[cfg(test)]`-only, not linkable from this doc comment). |
| `LEXER_DECORATORS` | `@decorator` spellings from the lexer (stable order). |
| `LEXER_AT_DECORATORS` | Every `@` decorator with a dedicated lexer `Token::At*` variant (56 — mirrors `vox_compiler::feature_matrix::DecoratorFeature::ALL`). |
| `LEXER_DEPRECATED_KEYWORDS` | Keywords that are deprecated and will be removed in a future version. LSP and introspection tools should avoid suggesting these. |
| `LEXER_DEPRECATED_DECORATORS` | Decorators that are retired and produce hard compiler errors. LSP and introspection tools should avoid suggesting these. |
| `SURFACE_BUILTIN_NAMES` | Builtin names for LSP / MCP “surface” introspection (aligned with common runtime helpers). |
| `LSP_BUILTIN_SNIPPETS` | LSP builtin snippets: `(name, insertText)`. |
| `SURFACE_TYPE_NAMES` | Surface type names shown in completions / introspection. |
